items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: Well Paul Whiteman got a raw deal I thought, you know, the “King of Jazz.”

ctx.x: What about the opposite. Is there someone that comes to mind that you think had minimal talent or individuality but managed to really be at the top of the record charts?

Well Paul Whiteman got a raw deal I thought, you know, the “King of Jazz.” I thought they treated him, a reverse discrimination. Because that’s not answering your question, but they treated him poorly. Because he had great jazz players in his group and he had two things answered. I always have my students take a look at Duke Ellington and Paul Whiteman. And one of the things that my book is trying to show is objectivity.
